subtitle: Vegan, no added sugar, for building muscle at 158 lb (72 kg). Two meals a day: a breakfast routine and a soup bowl, about 1,870 kcal and 123 g protein.
safety: Check with the doctor before switching to two meals a day if you take daily medicines. Some can cause low sugar with long gaps between meals.

Morning tablet: take it first thing in the morning with plain water. Wait at least 1 hour before black tea or coffee, and keep soy foods, soy milk and calcium or iron tablets 4 hours away. Meal 1 at noon fits this.
Protein: at 158 lb (72 kg), aim for 1.6 g per kg a day, about 115 g. The two meals give about 123 g.
Weight: weigh yourself once a week. If you lose weight you want to keep, add 1 cup soymilk or ½ cup more quinoa; if you gain fat, drop the walnuts to ½ oz.
Supplements: vitamin B12 is a must on a vegan diet. Ask the doctor about vitamin D and an algae omega-3, and check B12, vitamin D, iron and other routine blood tests every year.
Psyllium: drink a full glass of water with it, and take medicines 2 hours apart from it.
No added sugar, and choose unsweetened soymilk and an unsweetened protein powder. Whole fruit, not juice.
Between meals: water, black coffee, black or green tea, all without sugar. Drink 3 litres of water a day, more on gym days.
Low sugar (shaky, sweaty, confused): take 3 glucose tablets or half a glass of fruit juice right away, then eat.

items: ½ cup Eden Foods Edensoy Unsweetened soymilk
1 tsp Spectrum Essentials organic ground flaxseed
meals.why: Blend the soymilk, protein powder, flax, psyllium and berries with 1 cup water and drink it right away, before the psyllium thickens. Eat the nuts and hemp hearts on the side.

items: ½ block Kirkland Signature Organic Extra Firm Tofu (8 oz), cubed
½ cup dry green or brown lentils
3 cups soup vegetables: broccoli, carrots and celery
1 tbsp olive oil and 2 tbsp nutritional yeast
Low-sodium vegetable broth or water, iodised salt and pepper
meals.why: Simmer the lentils and quinoa in the broth for 20 minutes, add the vegetables for 10, then the tofu for the last 5. Cook a double pot and keep half in the fridge for the next day.
